Hyderabad Police Advise Caution in Hiring Domestic Help

Hyderabad Police have urged citizens to exercise caution and verify the identities of domestic workers they hire. This advisory follows reports of 565 theft cases involving domestic help in the city over the past two years. Citizens are encouraged to report any suspicious activity by calling 100 or contacting the Hyderabad City Police WhatsApp helpline. The police also advised vigilance when hiring individuals for household work.
